article_title: Why growing older LGBTQ+ community in Britain fears losing identity

tasks.prompt: What central concern does the report raise about care for older LGBTQ+ people?
options: Fear of discrimination can force people to conceal identity or delay needed care
All older LGBTQ+ people already have specialist housing
Every care provider requires residents to display flags
The report claims family support is identical for all groups
tasks.correct_answer: Fear of discrimination can force people to conceal identity or delay needed care
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת חשש שאנשים יסתירו זהות או ידחו טיפול לנוכח אפליה אפשרית.

tasks.prompt: What does Manchester's planned Kindred House offer?
options: A hospital exclusively for young people
80 self-contained apartments, communal areas and access to a 24/7 care team
A compulsory boarding school for older people
Only private ownership with no staff training
tasks.correct_answer: 80 self-contained apartments, communal areas and access to a 24/7 care team
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המיזם מציע 80 דירות עצמאיות, חללים משותפים, צוות טיפול זמין והכשרה ייעודית.

tasks.prompt: What does “back into the closet” mean in the report's warning?
options: Returning to a childhood home
Putting personal objects in storage
Concealing LGBTQ+ identity again
Moving out of a care home permanently
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מציין חזרה להסתרת הזהות המינית או המגדרית בגלל חשש מהיחס בסביבת טיפול.

tasks.prompt: In Mindy's account, what does “clumping you together with other stereotypes” mean?
options: Recognising each person's history
Helping people choose friends
Providing specialist health services
Treating older people as a single stereotyped group
tasks.correct_answer: Treating older people as a single stereotyped group
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מינדי מתארת הכללה שמוחקת הבדלים וזהויות בין אנשים מבוגרים.

tasks.prompt: How does Norman describe his “chosen family”?
options: His partner Tony and supportive friends and neighbours
Only relatives living nearby
Staff at a care home he already lives in
People he has never met online
tasks.correct_answer: His partner Tony and supportive friends and neighbours
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נורמן מתייחס לבן זוגו, לחברים ולשכנים כמערכת תמיכה מבחירה.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean that demand may “outstrip supply” of specialist services?
options: Housing will become free for everyone
Need for services may grow faster than their availability
The number of people will decline sharply
Existing apartments will all be converted to hospitals
tasks.correct_answer: Need for services may grow faster than their availability
tasks.explanation_hebrew: outstrip supply משמעו ביקוש העולה על היצע השירותים הזמינים.

tasks.prompt: Why might some older LGBTQ+ people postpone formal care despite needing it?
expected_points: Some fear homophobia or mistreatment by carers
They may hide wedding photographs or flags
Past discrimination can shape expectations of institutions
Norman worries about reports of poor treatment in nursing homes
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לייחס את החשש לעדויות ולדו״ח, ולא לטעון שכל מסגרות הטיפול מפלות.

tasks.prompt: Compare Tonic in London and the planned Kindred House in Manchester.
expected_points: Kindred House is planned to open next year with 80 apartments
Kindred House provides independently lived-in extra-care accommodation
Both aim to offer supportive LGBTQ+ communities
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין הבדלי תאריך, היקף או מודל טיפול, ואת המכנה המשותף בלי לבלבל בין המיזמים.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how personal testimony and the report's figures explain demand for inclusive later-life care.
expected_points: Mindy describes being mistaken for straight or having her wife misidentified
Norman relies on a chosen family but worries about formal care
The report notes elevated isolation and lower availability of help in some groups
Over-50s identifying as lesbian, gay or bisexual rose from about 340,000 to nearly 460,000 between 2019 and 2024
Specialist provision may not keep pace with growing demand
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית עדויות ונתונים בזהירות, עם ייחוס והימנעות מהכללות לכלל הקהילה.

tasks.prompt: Explain how Kindred House and Tonic address more than medical needs, using the experiences of two interviewees.
expected_points: Kindred House includes communal spaces and trained care staff
Tonic provided Min with community after Tim died
Mindy values staff and rules designed with LGBTQ+ inclusion in mind
Norman emphasises both chosen family and respectful formal care
Residents seek safety without having to conceal or explain identity
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית על תחושת שייכות, זהות וביטחון לצד טיפול, עם שתי דוגמאות מהכתבה.
